# Flow Education Edition

> Total.js Flow prepared to be used in a classroom, built with UPM (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid). Based on Total.js Flow 11, it runs inside OpenPlatform: students work only with their own FlowStreams, teachers see all of them and hand out practice templates to groups or to every student. English and Spanish.

Node.js 24, Total.js 5, plain JavaScript (no TypeScript). Docker image: `ghcr.io/totaljs-es/flowee`. MIT license.

- [Release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/flowee/main/version): What changed in the edition

## Code

- [Access rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/flowee/main/definitions/education.js): Who can work with which FlowStream
- [Classroom plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/flowee/main/plugins/classroom/index.js): Practice templates, copies for groups and students
- [OpenPlatform module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/flowee/main/modules/openplatform.js): Session and users of OpenPlatform
- [Tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/flowee/main/tests/education.js): A fake OpenPlatform, a teacher and three students
